description:
Delete a chosen set of your notifications. This cannot be undone.

    Returns your resulting unread count — and nothing about the ids
    themselves. A per-id result would report which of the submitted ids
    were real and yours, which is an enumeration oracle a hundred
    guesses at a time.

ids.description: Notification ids to delete permanently (max 100). Ids that do not exist or belong to someone else are ignored.
ids.title: Ids

name: colony_delete_notifications_batch
